_doc: Graphics presets and the frame cap applied by game/settings/settings.gd (frame_cap: Engine.max_fps while the game has the focus and while another application has it; 0 = no cap). shadow_size: the sun's atlas, a quarter per cascade; shadow_filter: RenderingServer.ShadowQuality, Soft Medium and up keep the dither of the filter off plain roofs (Godot docs, 3D lights and shadows): modelling choices.
